```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(tidyr)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
risk <- eligible_risk_set(collect(tbl(con, "outcomes")))
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
hazard <- risk |>
  group_by(eligible_season_index) |>
  summarise(
    seasons = n(),
    across(c(outcome_drafted_d, outcome_signed_udfa_d, outcome_nfl_entry_d), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(seasons >= 100)
hazard_long <- hazard |>
  select(
    eligible_season_index,
    seasons,
    Drafted = outcome_drafted_d,
    `Undrafted free agent` = outcome_signed_udfa_d,
    `NFL entry` = outcome_nfl_entry_d
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(eligible_season_index, seasons), names_to = "outcome", values_to = "p")
hz <- function(k, col = "outcome_nfl_entry_d") {
  hazard[[col]][hazard$eligible_season_index == k]
}
hz_tip <- function(k, outcome, p, n) {
  sprintf("Eligible season %d, %s: %.1f%% of %s seasons", k, outcome, 100 * p, fmt(n))
}
entry <- filter(hazard_long, outcome == "NFL entry")

p <- ggplot(
  filter(hazard_long, outcome != "NFL entry"),
  aes(eligible_season_index, p, colour = outcome)
) +
  geom_line(data = entry, aes(eligible_season_index, p), linewidth = 1.4, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey35") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.4) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = hz_tip(eligible_season_index, outcome, p, seasons)), size = 3) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    data = entry,
    aes(eligible_season_index, p, tooltip = hz_tip(eligible_season_index, outcome, p, seasons)),
    size = 3,
    colour = "grey35"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1,
    y = hz(3) + 0.04,
    label = sprintf("NFL entry chance (dashed)\nin the third eligible season: %.1f%%", 100 * hz(3)),
    size = 5.5,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x), limits = c(0, 0.25)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = hazard$eligible_season_index) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Drafted = "#1B9E77", `Undrafted free agent` = "#7570B3")) +
  labs(
    title = "Per-season chance of each NFL outcome",
    subtitle = "By eligible season number; dashed line is NFL entry by either route",
    x = "Eligible season number",
    y = "Chance that season",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "entry-chance-by-eligible-season", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-era
y0 <- min(risk$draft_year)
y1 <- max(risk$draft_year)
hazard_era <- risk |>
  mutate(
    era = cut(
      draft_year,
      breaks = c(y0 - 1, 2016, 2021, y1),
      labels = c(
        sprintf("%d to 2016 classes", y0),
        "2017 to 2021 classes",
        sprintf("2022 to %d classes", y1)
      )
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(era, eligible_season_index) |>
  summarise(seasons = n(), p = mean(outcome_nfl_entry_d), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(seasons >= 100)
p_era <- ggplot(hazard_era, aes(eligible_season_index, p, colour = era)) +
  geom_line_interactive(aes(data_id = era, tooltip = era), linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      data_id = era,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s, eligible season %d: %.1f%% entered the NFL (%s seasons)",
        era,
        eligible_season_index,
        100 * p,
        fmt(seasons)
      )
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x), limits = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(hazard_era$eligible_season_index)) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Per-season chance of NFL entry, by era of draft classes",
    subtitle = "By eligible season number",
    x = "Eligible season number",
    y = "Chance the next draft\nbrings NFL entry",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = "Era and season cells with fewer than 100 player-seasons omitted. Hover a line to isolate an era."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_era)
```
